meta.hero_eyebrow: Private Itinerary · Prepared by Keith Pence, Suites With Keith
meta.hero_line: MacArthur Place, Sonoma · September 28 to October 2, 2026
meta.hero_alt: Suite with balcony and fireplace at MacArthur Place, Sonoma
meta.hello: Craig and Claudine, here's the whole trip in one place. Four nights at MacArthur Place, a private wine day, four good dinners, and plenty of room to wander. Keep this open on your phones, everything runs in order.
meta.how_to_read: Tap any day below to jump straight to it. Every address opens in Google Maps and every phone number is tap to call. Anything marked To be confirmed is in hand on my side and gets filled in here as it lands.

hotel.name: MacArthur Place Hotel & Spa
hotel.maps_query: MacArthur Place Hotel & Spa, 29 E MacArthur St, Sonoma, CA 95476
hotel.room_details: One king bed plus pull-out sleeper sofa, private balcony, gas fireplace, soaking tub and walk-in shower

days.title: Arrival & an easy first night
days.summary: Fly into San Francisco, pick up the rental car and drive up to Sonoma, check in at MacArthur Place, then walk to dinner on the Plaza.

events.title: Arrive San Francisco, pick up the rental car, up to Sonoma
events.details: Rental car confirmed by you. Roughly 1 hour 15 minutes from SFO to MacArthur Place via 101 North and Highway 37 / 121, longer with traffic. Send me your landing time when you have it and I'll let the hotel know when to expect you.

events.title: Check in at MacArthur Place, Julia Suite
events.maps_query: MacArthur Place Hotel & Spa, 29 E MacArthur St, Sonoma, CA 95476
events.keith_todo: Check-in time of 4:00 PM is assumed, confirm with the hotel.

events.title: Dinner at the girl & the fig
events.maps_query: the girl & the fig, 110 W Spain St, Sonoma, CA
events.distance: About a 10 minute walk from the hotel, right on the Plaza
events.keith_note: Easy first night after you get in. French-inspired country food, great fig and arugula salad, lively room.

days.title: Split morning, then a private wine tour
days.summary: Craig heads to Marin for an early guided ride while Claudine has a spa morning. Everyone is back at MacArthur by 12:45 for a 1:00 PM pickup, then dinner five minutes away at Wit & Wisdom.

events.title: Guided mountain bike ride in Marin with NorCal Flow
Ageless Radiance facial, 50 minutes
events.location: The Spa at MacArthur, on property
events.details: Arrive 15 minutes early. Guaranteed on the card on file, with a 24 hour cancellation policy.

events.title: Energy Boost body treatment, 50 minutes
events.location: The Spa at MacArthur, on property
events.details: Back to back with the facial, done by about 11:00 AM. The whirlpool, steam room and relaxation garden are complimentary before and after.

events.title: The Explorer, private wine tour with Bohemian Highway Travel Co.
events.details: Private host and driver in a Land Rover Defender 110, with two tastings chosen around Craig's Pinot and Cab and Claudine's Sauvignon Blanc, plus a chef-prepared picnic lunch. Your host is Jason. Expect to be back at the hotel around 5:00 to 5:30 PM. Gratuities for the host and the wineries are not included and are at your discretion.

stops.name: Dunstan at Durell Vineyard
stops.maps_query: Dunstan Wines, Durell Vineyard, Sonoma, CA
stops.note: A tasting in the 1920s farmhouse overlooking one of Sonoma's most storied vineyards. Your picnic lunch from Bloom Carneros is served here.

stops.name: John Anthony, Church Vineyard
stops.maps_query: John Anthony Vineyards Church Vineyard, Carneros, Napa, CA
stops.note: An 1886 church in the heart of Carneros, surrounded by Sauvignon Blanc vines. A seated wine and food pairing from the winery chef.

events.title: Dinner at Wit & Wisdom Tavern
events.location: 1325 Broadway, Sonoma, CA 95476, inside The Lodge at Sonoma
events.maps_query: Wit & Wisdom Tavern, 1325 Broadway, Sonoma, CA
events.distance: About 5 minutes from MacArthur Place by car, roughly a 15 minute walk
events.keith_note: Claudine flagged this menu specifically. Michael Mina's wine country tavern, wood-fired everything. You'll have a couple of hours back at the hotel to reset after the tour first.

days.title: A free day in Sonoma
days.summary: Nothing scheduled until dinner. A slow morning, a hike or a coast drive, lunch or a bar snack at Layla downstairs, then a walk to Cafe La Haye.

events.title: Ideas for the day
events.details: No wrong answer here. Jenner is about an hour and 15 minutes from the hotel, so make a day of it if you head for the coast.
bullets: A drive out to the Sonoma coast, Bodega Bay and Highway 1

bullets.text: Coastal hike: the Kortum Trail from Shell Beach, an easy bluff-top walk toward Goat Rock, just south of Jenner
bullets.maps_query: Shell Beach Trailhead, Kortum Trail, Sonoma Coast State Park, Jenner, CA

bullets.text: Coastal hike: Jenner Headlands Preserve, a bigger climb with huge views over the mouth of the Russian River

bullets: A hike closer to home at Jack London State Historic Park or Sonoma Valley Regional Park
Walk-in tastings around the Sonoma Plaza
Lunch, or a drink and a few plates, at Layla downstairs from your room. No reservation needed

events.title: Dinner at Cafe La Haye
events.maps_query: Cafe La Haye, 140 E Napa St, Sonoma, CA
events.distance: Right off the Plaza, a short walk from the hotel
events.keith_note: Sonoma institution, tiny room, seasonal Northern California cooking. No driving, no logistics, just a really lovely local night.

days.title: Healdsburg day, then Glen Ellen Star
days.summary: A self-guided day up in Healdsburg, about an hour north, a straight shot up 12 and 101: a seated tasting at Flowers, a late lunch, shopping around the square, and an afternoon stop at the Siduri tasting room. Head back down by about 6:00 PM for dinner at Glen Ellen Star.

events.title: Up to Healdsburg
events.details: About an hour from the hotel to House of Flowers on Westside Road, a few minutes west of downtown Healdsburg. After tastings, a ride share is the wiser call.

events.title: Sonoma Coast Journey tasting at Flowers Vineyards & Winery
events.location: House of Flowers, 4035 Westside Road, Healdsburg, CA 95448
events.maps_query: House of Flowers, 4035 Westside Rd, Healdsburg, CA 95448
events.details: A seated tasting of Flowers' Sonoma Coast Chardonnay and Pinot Noir at House of Flowers, their tasting house in the hills above Westside Road. Plan to arrive a few minutes early. If you're running more than 15 minutes behind, give them a call so they hold your table. Guests must be 21 and over.
events.keith_note: Some of the best coastal Pinot in the state, and the setting is as good as the wine.

events.title: Late lunch and a wander around the Healdsburg Plaza
events.details: Two I like, both right by the Plaza.

bullets.text: Roof 106, the rooftop at The Matheson
bullets.maps_query: Roof 106 at The Matheson, 106 Matheson St, Healdsburg, CA
Lo & Behold Bar + Kitchen, 214 Healdsburg Ave, Healdsburg, CA

events.title: Siduri Wines tasting room, downtown Healdsburg
events.location: Siduri Wines tasting lounge, Healdsburg Plaza
events.maps_query: Siduri Wines tasting lounge, Healdsburg, CA
events.details: Claudine's pick. I left this one open: walking in should be totally fine, or you can secure a reservation at the link below if you'd rather lock a time. Aim for mid-afternoon so you're on the road out of Healdsburg by 6:00 PM.

events.title: Back down valley toward Glen Ellen
events.details: Healdsburg to Glen Ellen Star is roughly 45 to 50 minutes.

events.title: Dinner at Glen Ellen Star
events.maps_query: Glen Ellen Star, 13648 Arnold Dr, Glen Ellen, CA
events.distance: About 15 minutes north of MacArthur Place
events.keith_note: Wood-fired, Ari Weiswasser's place, one of the best rooms in the valley.

days.title: Departure
days.summary: Check out of MacArthur Place and head home.

events.title: Check out, MacArthur Place
events.keith_todo: Check-out time of 11:00 AM is assumed, confirm with the hotel. Departure flight not yet shared.

good_to_know.title: Layla, downstairs
good_to_know.text: The hotel restaurant is right below your room. It is closed for dinner Monday and Tuesday, so think lunch one afternoon, or drinks and a few plates at the bar. No reservation needed.

good_to_know.title: Spa hours
good_to_know.text: Spa amenities are open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday to Thursday and 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Friday to Sunday: indoor lounge, locker rooms, the outdoor relaxation garden with whirlpool and co-ed steam room, and a fitness room with Peloton bikes, a Woodway treadmill and TRX.

good_to_know.title: Pool
good_to_know.text: The pool and outdoor whirlpool are open 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily.

good_to_know.title: Tipping on the wine tour
good_to_know.text: Gratuities for your Bohemian Highway driver and the winery hosts are not included. They are at your discretion.

good_to_know.title: After tastings
good_to_know.text: Please don't drive after tastings. Tuesday is fully driven for you. For everything else, a ride share is the easy call.

good_to_know.title: Healdsburg on Thursday
good_to_know.text: You chose a ride share each way over a driver, which makes sense. It is about 45 minutes in each direction, so request the ride back with a little buffer before dinner.

keith.title: Travel Advisor, Suites With Keith (Fora)
keith.headline: I'm here if anything comes up
keith.note: I grew up in Marin and my grandparents have lived in Calistoga since the 1970s, so wine country is home turf. Text me any time during the trip, for anything at all.
